Kathi.

messages.author: d9ced0277ffec420
messages.subject: Re: WRMR
parts:
If I read the formula correctly [ http://www.statmodel.com/download/techappen.pdf ], the calculation of the WRMR for categorical measures would be (assuming the [WLSMV] fitted object is named *fit*)

vars <- dim(inspect(fit,"sampstat")$cov)[1]
fmin <- fitMeasures(fit, "fmin")
N <- nobs(fit)
e <- (vars*(vars+1))/2
sqrt((2*N*fmin)/e)
